title: An Empirical Analysis of Consumer Purchase Behavior of Base Products and Add-ons Given Compatibility Constraints
authors: Xiao Liu; Timothy P. Derdenger; Baohong Sun
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Dynamic structural model of digital-camera and memory-card purchases under compatibility constraints, estimated by likelihood in MATLAB; SAS used for descriptive tables and a price regression.
design_notes: DataReplication/Code/LLDP_*.m, log_likelihood*.m (dynamic model, Table 6); Tables.sas proc reg lqc = lpc lpm pm (descriptive price/quality regression); policy simulations SimNoCom.m, SimEKC.m. No treatment timing.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract, README and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
